name: Kuching Half Marathon 2027 Powered By Ultron
short_description: Kuching Half Marathon 2027 Powered By Ultron is on Sunday 10 January 2027 at Majlis Bandaraya Kuching Selatan in Kuching, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Kuching Half Marathon 2027 Powered By Ultron is a JomRun event based at Majlis Bandaraya Kuching Selatan (MBKS) in Kuching, Sarawak, on 10 January 2027. It offers a 21.1 km competitive run plus 5 km and 10 km fun runs, and JomRun lists the event time as 3:30 am.

faqs.question: When is the Kuching Half Marathon 2027 Powered By Ultron?
faqs.answer: It is on Sunday 10 January 2027 at Majlis Bandaraya Kuching Selatan. JomRun lists the event time as 3:30 am, while race kit collection and the route map are still marked to be confirmed.

faqs.question: Which distances can runners choose?
faqs.answer: The event offers a 21.1 km competitive run and 5 km and 10 km fun runs. The 21.1 km is the timed competitive category.
